# A Canadian book that writes `$residual$` on a transaction with no foreign
# currency in it at all.
#
# `$residual$` is available on any transaction, not only a currency disposal:
# one split writes it in place of an amount and takes what the others leave
# over, the way GnuCash's editor fills an Imbalance line once an account is
# chosen. Paying the rent that way is ordinary bookkeeping.
#
# What this fixture is for: nothing here is an exchange difference, so every
# gain key on the sheet must read 0.00 and the working must list nothing. A
# report that marks every residual split states this rent as a realized
# exchange loss of 900.00 CAD and itemises it as one — a figure invented out of
# a domestic expense, on a book holding no foreign currency whatever.
#
# - 2026-01-02  10,000.00 CAD of opening capital.
# - 2026-03-01  900.00 CAD of rent, the expense side written as `$residual$`.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity:Opening balances
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Rent
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 10000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening balances -10000.00 CAD

2026-03-01 * "Rent for March"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank -900.00 CAD
	Expenses:Rent $residual$ CAD
